description:
e-Trace provides end-to-end cybersecurity expertise, combining offensive and defensive security, digital forensics, security governance, cloud infrastructure, and artificial intelligence. Its capabilities span vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, incident response, malware analysis, risk management, secure infrastructure engineering, and advanced digital investigations. Dedicated laboratories and multidisciplinary specialists enable the company to address complex security challenges across enterprise, public sector, and critical infrastructure environments.
Founded in 2007, e-Trace brings nearly two decades of experience supporting public institutions, private enterprises, and organizations operating in sensitive and mission-critical environments. Originally established as a pioneer in Italian Computer Forensics, the company has progressively expanded its expertise to encompass the entire cybersecurity lifecycle. Its track record includes complex infrastructure projects, security assessments, digital investigations, and long-term advisory engagements, including activities supporting European institutions and the space sector.
e-Trace operates through eight integrated business areas: Cybersecurity, Security Governance, Digital Forensics, Security Training, Security Consulting, Cloud & Infrastructure, Artificial Intelligence, and Research & Development. These capabilities are complemented by a specialized technology distribution business representing leading international vendors in digital forensics and cybersecurity. This multidisciplinary structure enables e-Trace to deliver consulting, technology integration, professional services, training, and proprietary solutions through a single accountable partner.
 e-Trace combines internationally recognized professional certifications with specialized technical qualifications and accredited testing capabilities. Its specialists hold credentials including CISSP, CISA, CEH, and CompTIA Security+, alongside vendor-specific certifications. The company operates an Accredited Testing Laboratory (LAP), officially recognized by the Italian National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN), supporting security testing and validation of critical ICT systems and infrastructure. Its innovation activities include proprietary developments such as Clue Warp and Skylab, demonstrating its commitment to applied research and technological advancement.

description:
SpaceOro is building Europe’s next generation of lunar infrastructure, with Latvia at the heart of a new era of commercial lunar access.

Its flagship mission, RedLunar, is a 12U lunar orbiter designed to operate in a frozen low lunar polar orbit for 36 months, opening the Moon to scientific research, technology demonstrations, and commercial hosted payloads at a fraction of the traditional mission cost.

RedLunar is the foundation of a scalable programme of up to ten lunar orbital missions, designed to establish a repeatable presence around the Moon rather than treating every mission as an isolated achievement. Beyond orbit, SpaceOro is developing Red1, a reusable low Earth orbit-to-low lunar orbit cargo vehicle, alongside a lunar lander concept to extend its capabilities from orbital infrastructure to lunar logistics.

By integrating spacecraft missions, hosted payload services, and full mission operations into a long-term commercial architecture, SpaceOro aims to make lunar access more accessible, repeatable, and commercially sustainable.

Our ambition is bigger than a spacecraft. It is to help build Europe’s independent lunar infrastructure, strengthen European strategic autonomy, and establish Latvia as a meaningful contributor to the next chapter of space exploration.

c@spaceoro.com
entityDescription:
SIA Brain Network, operating as SpaceOro, is a Latvian space company focused on building a long-term lunar orbital programme. Its first mission, RedLunar, is a 12U CubeSat designed to operate in a frozen low lunar polar orbit, with a planned operational lifetime of 36 months and the potential for a further 24-month extension.
RedLunar will provide a platform for universities, space agencies and commercial partners to fly scientific instruments and technology demonstrations to lunar orbit, with SpaceOro managing mission operations. The company plans to build on this first mission with a series of up to ten lunar orbital missions.
Beyond RedLunar, SpaceOro is developing Red1, a reusable cargo vehicle concept for transport from low Earth orbit to low lunar orbit, alongside a lunar lander concept. The long-term goal is to make lunar orbit more accessible and affordable for smaller payloads while developing European capabilities in space systems and lunar infrastructure.

entityDescription:
Alberami S.r.l. Società Benefit is an innovative environmental Agri-tech company based in Lecce, in the southern Italian region of Puglia, dedicated to advancing sustainable agricultural practices across the Mediterranean. Following the acquisition in 2025 of Esférico MRV Systems, a Spanish technology company based in Murcia and specialized in MRV (Measurement, Reporting and Verification) solutions for agriculture, the company operates under the Radica brand.
Through its flagship project, AgroEcology_Italy, Radica supports Italian farmers in adopting regenerative agriculture practices, including agroforestry, tree planting, and soil improvement techniques, with a particular focus on reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and enhancing carbon sequestration.
Radica's core mission is to empower local farmers with the tools, financial incentives, and expert guidance required to transition from conventional to sustainable agriculture. By promoting practices that reduce reliance on synthetic fertilizers and pesticides, Radica helps improve soil health, increase biodiversity, and foster environmental resilience. This transformative initiative not only addresses urgent climate change concerns by capturing carbon in soil and biomass but also revitalizes agricultural communities by creating economic opportunities within the voluntary carbon market.
Radica's approach integrates scientifically-backed methodologies and advanced technologies, such as satellite monitoring and IoT-enabled data collection, to accurately measure the impacts of regenerative practices on carbon sequestration and ecosystem health. The company's projects follow robust frameworks, including the LIFE C-Farms methodology and standards by Verra and the International Carbon Registry, ensuring high levels of accountability and transparency in carbon credit generation.
As a Società Benefit, Radica operates with a dual-purpose mission: generating financial returns while achieving substantial positive environmental and social impacts. This unique structure allows Radica to align its business operations closely with sustainability goals, ensuring long-term benefits for both the environment and the agricultural sector. Through collaborations with local stakeholders, research institutions, and regional governments, Radica aims to expand its reach, with a projected goal of cultivating sustainable practices across at least 250,000 hectares in Italy and 500,000 hectares in Spain by 2030.
By fostering a model of agroforestry and regenerative agriculture, Radica not only contributes to climate change mitigation and biodiversity conservation but also positions itself as a leader in sustainable land management in the Mediterranean, aiming to inspire broader adoption of eco-friendly practices in agriculture across Europe and beyond.

entityDescription:
Enline delivers sensor-agnostic Digital Twin and AI technology, empowering the energy sector to monitor, maintain, and optimise grid assets in real time, boosting efficiency, reliability, and sustainability across transmission and distribution networks, as well as renewable sites. Headquartered in Portugal, Enline counts on collaborators all around the world.
Enline leverages digital twin technology to create a virtual replica of power assets, such as power grids and generation systems (production, transformation, etc.), enabling real-time monitoring and predictive analytics without additional sensors or hardware by employing peer-reviewed algorithms, finite element methods and AI techniques. This innovative, sensor-agnostic approach provides valuable insights into the overall asset status, empowering the energy sector to optimise performance, proactively address potential issues, and overcome unique challenges.
The global energy transition, driven by massive investments in renewable energy and the electrification of society, presents an urgent challenge: power grids worldwide must be modernised and digitalised to handle unprecedented variability and complexity. Grids initially designed for centralised, predictable power flow struggle to cope, resulting in costly renewable energy curtailment, congestion-related economic losses, and catastrophic costs from extreme weather-driven outages. To achieve a resilient, net-zero future, new digital solutions are urgently needed to enable real-time flexibility, efficiency, and seamless integration of renewable energy sources globally.

Deep Sentrics Ltd. is a Bulgarian technology company specializing in artificial intelligence, advanced data analytics, information fusion, and decision-support systems for defence, security, and critical infrastructure applications.
The company develops AI-powered solutions for multi-source data integration, intelligence analysis, strategic foresight, and situational awareness. Its core capabilities include machine learning, natural language processing, knowledge graphs, geospatial intelligence, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and distributed AI architectures.
Deep Sentrics develops and maintains the Strategic Foresight Analysis (SFA) platform for the NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA), supporting technology intelligence, emerging technology monitoring, and evidence-based decision-making.
Through its StrataSense and DeepVector solutions, the company is expanding into space-enabled applications, including satellite data exploitation, Earth observation analytics, multi-sensor fusion, maritime domain awareness, and AI-assisted monitoring of critical infrastructure.
Deep Sentrics aims to contribute to European space programmes by developing innovative downstream applications that transform satellite and complementary data sources into actionable intelligence for civil, commercial, and security users.

entityDescription: eXplorAI is a technology-oriented startup originating from Sapienza University of Rome, focused on the design, implementation, and validation of advanced software and robotic solutions for autonomous systems operating in complex, unstructured, and GNSS-denied environments. entityDescription:
Spectral Flow SAS is a French deep-tech company developing quantum magnetic sensors based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in synthetic diamond. The sensors work at room temperature, without cryogenics, shielding or vacuum. They are passive: they emit no signal and rely on no external radio signal, so there is no radio link to jam or spoof.
The company follows a design-led model. It covers the sensor architecture, the diamond material specification, the readout electronics and firmware, and the calibration and signal-processing layer, while diamond growth and wafer-level fabrication are carried out by established European partners. The first application is GNSS-denied navigation, using the Earth's crustal magnetic field as a passive positioning reference. The same sensing core addresses space applications: low-altitude and surface magnetic mapping of the Moon and Mars, where orbital maps lack the short-wavelength content that surface operations require; in-situ magnetic cleanliness verification of platforms and payloads; and boomless magnetometry, in which a four-chip gradiometer separates the platform's own field from the ambient field by geometry rather than by distance on a boom.
Design choices are checked in simulation before hardware is built. The first mobile prototype is in preparation. Performance figures are design targets, not measured results, with a conservative target of 70 pT/sqrt(Hz) per axis in DC operation.
Spectral Flow has sixteen UK provisional and two French patent applications, all filed in 2026, before any public disclosure. It is qualified as a Deeptech company by Bpifrance, which supports it with a French Tech Emergence grant, is accompanied by the Incubateur Provence Cote d'Azur, and is a member of the SAFE aerospace and defence cluster, of the European Quantum Industry Consortium (QuIC) and of NVIDIA Inception.
Capabilities offered to ESA and to prime contractors: feasibility and trade-off studies in quantum magnetometry; modelling of magnetic navigation and magnetic mapping at mission level; sensor and payload architecture definition; requirement derivation for magnetic instruments, including size, mass, power, thermal and radiation constraints; and participation in technology development activities up to breadboard and prototype level.

entityDescription: OmniLoc.ai is a Greece-based technology company developing AI-powered localisation solutions for autonomous systems operating in GNSS-degraded, denied, jammed or spoofed environments. Its proprietary technology combines satellite Earth Observation and aerial imagery with onboard RGB/IR cameras through advanced Cross-View Geolocalisation (CVGL), Bird’s-Eye View (BEV) representations and probabilistic multi-sensor fusion, enabling accurate, resilient and cost-effective positioning. The company's hardware-agnostic software platform targets UAVs, autonomous vehicles, robotics and defence and civil protection systems, supporting applications such as infrastructure inspection, surveying, emergency response and autonomous navigation. OmniLoc collaborates with industrial partners and technology providers to validate its solutions in real-world operational environments. Its software-first business model focuses on embedded SDKs, software licensing, customised integrations and strategic partnerships, facilitating the adoption and scaling of resilient localisation technologies across civilian and defence markets.

entityDescription: LI Aerospace Kft. is a Hungarian engineering and R&D company developing advanced electric machines and integrated drive systems for aerospace, space and specialised industrial applications. Its core technology under development is a permanent-magnet-free and rare-earth-free motor architecture combining axial and radial magnetic flux paths with internal three-dimensional flux routing within the rotor. The development aims to achieve high power density and efficiency while reducing mass, manufacturing costs and dependence on critical materials. Activities focus on electromagnetic design and simulation, thermal management, and motor–inverter–control integration. Potential applications include UAV propulsion, electrically driven rocket propellant pumps, electromechanical actuators and compact auxiliary drives for space systems.

entityDescription:
Mykolas Romeris University (MRU)
Mykolas Romeris University (MRU) is one of Lithuania’s leading universities in social sciences and humanities, actively engaged in interdisciplinary research, innovation, international cooperation and regional development.
The University comprises five academic divisions: Law School, Public Security Academy, Faculty of Human and Social Studies, Faculty of Public Governance and Business, and Sudovian Academy.
MRU Sudovian Academy, established in Marijampolė in 2024, strengthens regional higher education, applied research and technological innovation.
The Marijampolė Regional Open Access STEAM Centre, operating within MRU as a unit of the Research and Innovation Centre (MIC), promotes science, technology, engineering, arts and mathematics (STEAM) education through practical, inquiry-based and interdisciplinary activities.
The Centre provides access to educational laboratories and technological resources, supporting activities in robotics, digital technologies, engineering, environmental research and prototyping. It fosters scientific literacy, creativity, problem-solving and technological competences among students, teachers and the wider community.
MRU actively participates in national and international research and innovation projects, promoting collaboration between academia, educational institutions, industry and public organisations.
Through its research expertise, educational infrastructure and STEAM initiatives, MRU contributes to European cooperation in science, technology, innovation and the development of future STEM competences.

entityDescription: NANOMILITARY P.S.A. is an advanced deep-tech company specializing in the research, development, and commercialization of cutting-edge nanomaterials, 3D branched vertically aligned carbon nanostructures (CNSTs), and Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs) for aerospace, defense, and space applications. Our core innovations focus on ultralightweight, high-strength, near-zero thermal expansion (CTE) nanocomposites designed to replace heavy alloys in satellite optical benches and structural payloads. Furthermore, our proprietary technology ensures superior resistance to mechanical fatigue and active outgassing mitigation (compliant with ESA CVCM standards), supporting the development of resilient, high-performance next-generation space systems.
